description: Source code for the user search layer in Mattermost, implementing user search, index management, and autocomplete functionalities with support for multiple search engines.

classes.name: SearchUserStore
classes.description: Struct implementing user search, index management, and autocomplete functionalities, integrating with multiple search engines and user store.

methods.name: deleteUserIndex
methods.description: Deletes a user from all active search engine indexes.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Performs user search using available search engines or falls back to database search.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates a user and reindexes if successful.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a new user and indexes it.

methods.name: PermanentDelete
methods.description: Permanently deletes a user and removes from index.

methods.name: autocompleteUsersInChannelByEngine
methods.description: Performs user autocomplete in a channel using a specific search engine.

methods.name: getListOfAllowedChannels
methods.description: Determines allowed channels for user search based on restrictions and context.

methods.name: AutocompleteUsersInChannel
methods.description: Performs user autocomplete in a channel, trying multiple engines or falling back to database.
